messages:
samir: Quick sync — I have a PR blocked on architecture signoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9482. RFC (link to private doc): https://go/reports/rfc-2026. Main concerns: compatibility with runtime v2.1, KV-cache fallback semantics, and canary/rollback criteria. tagging @olivia for arch review.

maria: thanks for the ping. can you paste the short list of changes vs current runtime? makes it easier to skim.

samir: sure — TL;DR: 1) change batching window from 10ms->15ms for auto-batcher, 2) add a soft-fallback that routes to quantized variant on OOMs, 3) introduce a per-model prefix cache invalidation flag. no behavior change to API surface.

devin: sounds fine, my concern is perf regressions with the larger batching window for tail latency. request: include 95/99 latency before/after on a 4k token seq. would recommend canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h with automated rollback on 99p > baseline + 25%.

samir: noted — I can add numbers. current baseline (p50/p95/p99) on the benchmark harness: 12ms / 48ms / 130ms. local test with change: 14ms / 52ms / 160ms. Ill run the full perf harness and paste results.

olivia: thanks. arch feedback: we cant merge until the RFC includes explicit rollback criteria and SLO impact. also need clarity on the fallback routing table: which model variants are eligible, and how we detect/mark OOM vs transient error. please update RFC with those bullets. Ill take a look once updated — aiming for EOD review if updated in the next 6 hours.

jen: also tag the owners in the PR description (platform-owner, runtime-owner) so approvals are visible in CANARY gating. CI is green?

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #9482 — unit tests: 1424 passed, integration: 78 passed, e2e: queued.

samir: added perf link and owners in PR description: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9482#issuecomment-7000. Updated RFC with fallback table and rollback plan. pinging @olivia again.

olivia: saw the update. the rollback criteria look reasonable but need the full perf harness numbers (99p across models). if you can attach the harness output I'll review. otherwise I can do a quick scan and leave an arch :eyes: and request a follow-up for the detailed numbers post-merge with a stricter canary window.

samir: attaching harness output now (uploaded to infra artifacts). link: https://artifacts.redwood/reports/9482/perf-harness-2026.log. Ill also add a canary playbook snippet to the RFC.

olivia: great. thanks. marking this as "awaiting arch review" — Ill post a final LGTM if the artifacts match. otherwise will request one small tweak. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. if olivia posts LGTM today well coordinate merge timing to avoid the 18:00 PST deploy freeze window.

devin: +1 on avoiding late deploys. if we get LGTM, plan to schedule merge at 10:00 PST tomorrow to run the 24h canary.

samir: appreciate it — will hold off merging until we have arch LGTM and the scheduled window. thanks all.
